newsitem.title: USA: Bristol-Myers to add 2,000 people to research staff.
newsitem.headline: Bristol-Myers to add 2,000 people to research staff.

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co. said Wednesday that it plans to increase its research staff by about 2,000 people over the next five years and acquire a 433-acre research and office park in Hopewell Township, N.J.

The company said headquarters for its Pharmaceutical Research Institute will remain at its facility in Princeton, N.J., where it will build additional laboratory space to support the increased research staff.
Bristol-Myers currently has 4,000 employees worldwide in pharmaceutical research.
The company's research activities in recent years have expanded to include a network of 30 biotechnology and other research alliances.
The drug giant said it would acquire the Hopewell Township facilities from Mobil Corp. for $41.7 million.
